entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 9916 of 2024
Applicant :- Neeraj Alias Neeraj Kumar (Jeth) And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. (Home) Govt. Of U.P. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Sharma,Satya Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Jas Karan Lal Maurya learned A.G.A. for the State
and perused the record.

2. The present application has been filed with a prayer to quash the impugned Charge sheet
No.25/24 dated 09/01/2024 filed in Case No.5579 of 2024; Crime No.0251 of 2023; under Sections
498A/323/504/506/406 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P Act; Police station- Deeh, District Raebareli, Pending in
the Court: A.C.J.M-Iii, Raebareli, State Vs. Pankaj Kumar And others.
3.

entities.text: A.C.J.M-Iii, Raebareli, State Vs. Pankaj Kumar And others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At the very outset, counsel for the applicants states that the applicants will surrender before the court below and apply for bail.

However, he has submitted that the applicants may be granted the benefit of the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another Neeraj Alias Neeraj Kumar (Jeth) And 3 ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. (Home) ...

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another Neeraj Alias Neeraj Kumar (Jeth) And 3 ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. (Home)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186147567/
1 reported in (AIR 2022 SC 3386).
4.

It is therefore, directed that in case the applicants surrender before the Court below within three weeks from today and prefer bail application, the court below will decide the said bail application, as expeditiously as possible, taking into account the law laid down by the Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil (supra) and decide it in accordance with law.

.
